title: Array API mixed inputs: move y/sample_weight onto X's namespace/device BEFORE dtype-coupled validation
answers: TypeError: 'dtype' must be a dtype, not torch.dtype when fitting with numpy y and torch X
estimator fails when y and X come from different array libraries or devices
where should move_to be called in fit/score for array API support
body:
Symptom: fit/score raises `TypeError: 'dtype' must be a dtype, not torch.dtype` (or similar) when `y`/`sample_weight` come from a different array API namespace or device than `X` (e.g. numpy y with torch-GPU X).
Root cause: sklearn/linear_model/_glm/glm.py:_GeneralizedLinearRegressor.fit/score called `move_to` only after `check_array(y, dtype=X.dtype)` and `_check_sample_weight(sample_weight, X, dtype=...)`; those pass X's dtype (from X's namespace) into a validator running on y's namespace.
Fix pattern: right after validating X and getting `xp, _, device = get_namespace_and_device(X)`, call `y, sample_weight = move_to(y, sample_weight, xp=xp, device=device)`, then do any validation that uses X's dtype. `move_to` is a no-op when namespaces already match.
Constraints: applies to any estimator method whose y/sample_weight validation is dtype-coupled to X (fit, score, partial_fit). Do it in every such method; score in GLM needed its own move since it validates separately.
applies: Array API support in sklearn estimators accepting y/sample_weight alongside X
